Full-source review found the candidate broadly accurate and appropriately cautious about checklist recommendations versus guarantees across metering, pricing, provisioning, invoicing, credentials, webhooks, monitoring, export, and rollback. The production raw SHA-256 matches the trusted order; all five excerpts are byte-exact at their stated lines; candidate.md equals receipt.source_page; suggestions.json equals receipt.suggestions; the canonical URL, nested raw_files value, path-qualified raw backlink, absent source target, and all related links pass. Three factual-grounding defects prevent approval. First, properties is a direct documentation contradiction: the checklist includes properties under all required fields, while the dedicated ingest OpenAPI schema requires only customer_id, event_type, timestamp, and transaction_id and leaves properties optional. The 14/34-day difference is not itself a direct contradiction: the checklist asks teams to test backdating through 14 days, while the API and scale guide document support through 34 days; both can be true, and the narrower checklist test must not be restated as a competing maximum or retention contract. Second, production-checklist-invoice-dry-run cites only quote 2 at lines 119-121, which contains lifecycle, invoice.finalized, and delivery-path checks but not the proposed production test-customer event-to-invoice-to-webhook-to-payment exercise at lines 181-188. The quote set also omits the pricing, customer/contract, and final rollback sections summarized by the candidate. Third, the checklist places a client-style retry policy (5xx/network retry, 429 backoff, 4xx DLQ and alert) inside its webhook section, while the dedicated webhook source says Metronome retries any delivery response above 299. The candidate usefully says the checklist does not replace that outbound contract, but the webhook concept proposal calls all of these receiver checks and therefore blurs retry direction and ownership. Security and export proposals are bounded and promotion-safe. No new concept, comparison, company, index, or log suggestion is otherwise required.
